---
title: "hpa_quarto"
author: "Jierui wang"
---

calculate total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in forebrain = cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus
regions in human, pig and mouse.

```{r}
h <- sum(180,83,57,110)
p <- sum(109,157,31,45)
m <- sum(55,185,60,98)

print(paste("the total number of genes in human is", h))
print(paste("the total number of genes in pig is", p))
print(paste("the total number of genes in mouse is", m))
```

The highest number of genes with elevated expression was 430, in humans.
